method.baseline: two AgglomerativeClustering fits: full Ward tree for gap statistics, then second fit_predict for labels

interpretation: Eliminates one of two hierarchical fits (50% fewer fits); measured speedup rises from 1.72x to 1.89x on these inputs. Dendrogram-gap calculation remains Python.
limitations: Microbenchmark only; no full RAPTOR/RAG qualification or test suite run.
_hc_cut is a private scikit-learn API; project metadata permits versions >=1.4, so compatibility across the full declared range remains unqualified.
Measurements use the installed locked scikit-learn 1.9.1 and synthetic seeded vectors.
